verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents several first-party ways to operate the product in natural language. Its official MCP server handles reads, automations, one-time sends and segments "all through natural language prompts". There is also an in-product agent that builds segments from plain-text descriptions, plus a Slack agent you can give work to. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With the MCP server, you can do just about anything you can do in Customer.io via your AI tool of choice—read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and more—all through natural language prompts.
Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing in Customer.io.
When you go to create a segment, you can click **Describe segment** and the agent will help you build a segment from a plain-text description.
You can add the Customer.io agent to Slack, and ask it questions or give it work without leaving a thread.
